target_profile.system_boundary: Captured go.etcd.io/raft library, with RawNode caller serialization or the Node.run select loop owning raft transitions. Embedding application implements transport, durable storage and state-machine effects; in-repository MemoryStorage and rafttest queue processors are concrete reference implementations, not crash-durable storage evidence.
protocol_contexts: Per-node term, vote, role, leader, log and replication tracker
ownership: RawNode is thread-unsafe; Node.run serializes proposal, peer, timer, configuration, Ready and Advance events.
Application reliably processes each async storage target in order and delivers append responses after durable writes; separate targets may proceed independently.
Application applies committed configuration changes and retains ConfState; proposal return reports Step outcome, not commit.
unknowns: Production transport/authentication and durable-storage implementations are not supplied by this library boundary.

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Leader admits proposals, assigns log identity, replicates and consumes current-term voter Match quorums. Followers validate predecessor/conflicts and bound commit propagation.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: Campaign and role transitions use log freshness, term filtering, voter quorums and unapplied-configuration/snapshot eligibility. Transfer, CheckQuorum and read authority share this context.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Snapshot and Storage reconstruction recover log/configuration; probing and snapshot retry resynchronize lagging peers.
Application activates committed changes through checked simple/joint transitions; current voter sets qualify support and staged learners retain outgoing voting role.
Ready separates committed, applying and applied; asynchronous delivery requires local stability and blocks behind snapshots.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: Storage responses attest ordered durable append completion under caller contract; unstable identity and protocol term checks govern retirement and Storage reconstructs restart state.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: Node serializes raft through its loop; Propose waits only for Step result. Caller supplies retries, durable storage, ordered application and read-context completion.

behaviors.execution_owner: RawNode.readyWithoutAccept and newStorageAppendMsg/newStorageAppendRespMsg, serialized by the RawNode caller
behaviors.protocol_context: AsyncStorageWrites enabled; Ready includes outstanding or in-progress unstable entries, hard-state updates, snapshots, or responses waiting for append completion.
behaviors.trigger: Ready generation creates local append work and attached response messages.
legal_preconditions: Config requires reliable in-order processing per local target and durable append writes before responses; different append/apply targets may run independently.
writes: MsgStorageAppend.Responses with deferred protocol replies and a local MsgStorageAppendResp
async_boundaries: The embedding application must process local append work before delivering its attached responses; creation of the message itself does not perform storage IO.

The in-repository rafttest implementation queues local targets separately, processes the head of AppendWork, performs processAppend and then exposes attached responses. Its MemoryStorage is not disk durability evidence.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Wraps MsgAppResp, including leader self-acknowledgments, behind the append completion boundary.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Wraps vote/pre-vote responses behind append completion and records the current term in the local stabilization response.

behaviors.execution_owner: raft.Step called by RawNode.Step or internal methods; RawNode requires caller serialization
behaviors.protocol_context: Message term relative to current raft.Term; local storage responses enter the same term dispatch.
behaviors.trigger: Incoming protocol or local completion message.
implementation_guards: RawNode.Step rejects unexpected local message senders and responses from unknown nonlocal peers.
Step handles higher-term messages before per-state dispatch, except pre-vote and active-lease exceptions.
Lower-term MsgStorageAppendResp never calls stableTo for its entry index.
reads: Message Term, Type, Index, LogTerm, Snapshot
Current Term, Vote, lead, checkQuorum and electionElapsed
writes: On accepted storage append response, calls raftLog.stableTo using entry LogTerm and Index.
For attached snapshots calls appliedSnap even on the lower-term branch.
For storage apply completion uses final entry index and size through appliedTo.
important_branches: Higher-term ordinary messages cause becomeFollower; stale ordinary messages return without state-specific handling.
Vote eligibility combines prior vote/leader context with log freshness; real votes update Vote, pre-votes do not.

cross_activity_effects.A6: Current-term append completion may retire unstable entries; stale-term completion cannot do so through Step.
cross_activity_effects.A5: Application responses use a term-independent path; stale snapshot completion is explicitly preserved.

existing_protections: stableTo requires a present unstable entry with the supplied entry term and index; matching only an unstable snapshot does not retire entries.
appliedSnap clears only a matching snapshot index and uses max(index, prior applied) for application progress.

behaviors.protocol_context: Follower, candidate, pre-candidate and leader state transitions.
writes: reset changes Term and clears Vote only on term change; clears leader, transfer, votes, pendingConfIndex, readOnly and uncommittedSize.
reset reconstructs progress with remote Match zero and local Match at lastIndex.
becomeCandidate increments term and records self vote.
becomePreCandidate resets votes without increasing term or changing Vote.
becomeLeader enters replicate mode for itself and appends an empty entry, whose self-ack is deferred by send.
pendingReadIndexMessages is not cleared by reset; releasePendingReadIndexMessages drains it only after a current-term commit and re-enters the configured read protocol.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Rebuilds replication support for a new role and appends a current-term empty entry on leadership acquisition.
cross_activity_effects.A6: appendEntry queues its self-ack in msgsAfterAppend rather than immediately advancing local replication progress.

behaviors.protocol_context: Current role and term, applied voter configuration, current log and replication progress.
behaviors.trigger: RawNode.Propose or Node.Propose dispatches MsgProp; network append replication follows.
implementation_guards: Leader drops proposals when removed, transferring leadership, or exceeding uncommitted payload quota.
Configuration proposals may be replaced by empty normal entries when another configuration is unapplied or the joint transition is invalid, unless validation is disabled.
Followers forward only with a known leader and forwarding enabled; candidates drop proposals.
writes: appendEntry assigns current term/consecutive indexes and appends unstable entries.
Queues leader self MsgAppResp behind storage; broadcasts MsgApp with predecessor index/term and commit.
external_effects: Heartbeat commit is capped at min(peer Match, leader committed).
Missing predecessor or unavailable entries cause snapshot fallback when the peer is recently active.
async_boundaries: A successful proposal return is not a commit or client application acknowledgment.

cross_activity_effects.A6: Local self support is deferred through msgsAfterAppend.
cross_activity_effects.A7: Submission errors and dropped proposals require caller retry; client request deduplication is outside this core.

behaviors.protocol_context: Term checks already performed by Step; leader-provided contiguous entries and predecessor identity.
behaviors.trigger: MsgApp received by follower or candidate.
implementation_guards: A predecessor below committed returns existing committed index.
Otherwise predecessor term must match; conflicts at or below committed panic, conflicting uncommitted suffix is replaced.
Commit advances only to min(leader commit, last index covered by this append).
writes: Log suffix and committed index; deferred MsgAppResp acknowledging accepted extent or rejection with conflict hint.

cross_activity_effects.A6: Accepted/rejected append responses are placed behind the storage boundary by send.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Candidate adopts a current-term leader before processing its append.

behaviors.execution_owner: raft.stepLeader, ProgressTracker, quorum configurations and raftLog.maybeCommit
behaviors.protocol_context: Leader term and active incoming/outgoing voter sets.
behaviors.trigger: MsgAppResp after Step term filtering, or configuration application calls maybeCommit.
implementation_guards: Unknown peer has no progress and is ignored.
Positive MaybeUpdate only raises Match; rejects never raise Match and stale rejections do not lower Next.
Only voter IDs feed majority CommittedIndex; joint result is the smaller of the two majority indexes.
maybeCommit requires nonzero current term matching the local entry at the quorum index, and index greater than committed.
writes: Updates peer Match and replication mode/inflight bookkeeping.
Advances committed index, releases pending reads and broadcasts updated commit when possible.
existing_protections: New appends do not immediately increase leader Match; its own MsgAppResp is delayed by appendEntry/send.
Both majorities are required in joint state; learners do not add commit support.

cross_activity_effects.A2: Transfer sends TimeoutNow only once transferee Match reaches lastIndex.
cross_activity_effects.A3: Conflict hints and probing recover replication; exact divergent-tail optimization variants remain open.

behaviors.protocol_context: Role, current term, configured voter sets and pending committed configuration/snapshot work.
behaviors.trigger: Campaign/timeout, vote response, CheckQuorum or leadership transfer.
implementation_guards: promotable requires own progress, nonlearner status and no pending/in-progress snapshot.
hup refuses an election when committed unapplied configuration entries are found.
Campaign targets voter union and delays its self-vote response behind append completion.
Only the matching pre-vote or vote response type is counted; each ID records only its first vote.
Quorum vote result uses active voter configuration, including both joint majorities.
writes: Pre-vote win starts real campaign; real vote win installs leader; vote loss returns follower.
CheckQuorum can step down at same term; new election raises term.
Transfer to learner/self is ignored, otherwise proposals pause and catch-up precedes TimeoutNow; timeout aborts transfer.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Authority acquisition installs the role reset and new current-term empty append.
cross_activity_effects.A4: Eligibility and blocking on unapplied configuration constrain which context may form the next quorum.

behaviors.protocol_context: Application invokes change for committed configuration entry or rejects it per API; active configuration can lag committed log.
behaviors.trigger: Committed configuration entry applied or ConfState restored.
implementation_guards: Simple changes reject joint state, empty resulting voters, or more than one voter symmetric difference.
EnterJoint preserves old voters as outgoing; LeaveJoint removes outgoing-only progress and completes staged learners.
LearnersNext preserves outgoing voter role until leaving joint state.
Proposal validation is best-effort; disabling it requires caller serialization and verification.
writes: Replaces tracker Config/Progress with checked copies; existing progress retained for surviving members and new progress begins Match zero.
Leader removal/demotion optionally steps down; membership change recomputes commit or probes peers; removed transferee aborts transfer.
AutoLeave is proposed after application progress crosses pendingConfIndex when leader.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Changes which Match values contribute to quorum and can immediately advance commitment.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Alters campaign/transfer eligibility and optional leader step-down.
cross_activity_effects.A6: Returned ConfState must be retained in snapshots.

unknowns: Disabling proposal validation and application-level rejection policy are separate variants not selected for the first check.

behaviors.protocol_context: Restart from Storage or follower receives newer snapshot.
implementation_guards: loadState requires stored commit in available log range.
Snapshot at/below committed is ignored; restore requires follower role and recipient present in snapshot configuration.
Matching snapshot index/term advances commit without replacing log/config; otherwise snapshot replaces unstable log and restores ConfState.
writes: Restart reconstructs configuration, term/vote/commit and optional caller Applied before follower reset.
Snapshot installs committed index and pending unstable snapshot; rebuilding progress uses configuration reconstruction.

cross_activity_effects.A2: Pending snapshot blocks promotability until completion; restart begins follower with reconstructed term and vote.
cross_activity_effects.A5: Pending snapshot blocks committed entry delivery until cleared.
cross_activity_effects.A6: Stable Storage supplies reconstruction; storage corruption and cleanup are caller boundaries.

behaviors.execution_owner: RawNode Ready acceptance/Advance, raftLog application selection and raft.appliedTo
behaviors.protocol_context: Committed prefix, local stability and application quota; synchronous or asynchronous API mode.
behaviors.trigger: Ready emitted and accepted, then Advance or storage response.
implementation_guards: nextCommittedEnts blocks with a pending snapshot or exhausted applying quota.
Async mode caps delivery at min(committed, unstable.offset-1); synchronous mode may include committed unstable entries under Ready caller sequencing.
Advance panics in async mode; otherwise steps queued self-acks and completion messages.
writes: acceptReady marks unstable/applying work in progress and clears output queues.
Application completion moves applied forward and releases byte quota; already committed entries survive term change through zero-term responses.

cross_activity_effects.A6: Ready acceptance is not durable completion; async apply scheduling waits for local stable offset.
cross_activity_effects.A4: Application progress may trigger leaving joint configuration.
cross_activity_effects.A7: Application must correlate its own client completion with commands, not proposal return.

behaviors.protocol_context: ReadOnlySafe uses request-context keyed pending acknowledgments; lease mode requires CheckQuorum and clock assumptions.
behaviors.trigger: ReadIndex input, heartbeat acknowledgment, current-term commit or role reset.
implementation_guards: Non-singleton leader buffers reads until a current-term entry is committed.
ReadOnlySafe records local ack and broadcasts request context; current voter quorum of heartbeat acks releases requests through that context.
Unknown request context yields no stored ack set; callers must distinguish request contexts.
Lease mode returns current commit directly; ForgetLeader is disabled in that mode.
writes: Returns local ReadStates or forwarded MsgReadIndexResp with request context.
reset replaces readOnly acknowledgments; pendingReadIndexMessages survive and are reprocessed only after later current-term commitment.

cross_activity_effects.A7: ReadState is an index/context handoff; caller must wait for sufficient applied progress before serving the read.

unknowns: Cross-configuration pending read acknowledgment eligibility and duplicate context caller policy need focused analysis if selected.

facts.meaning: A generated local append response identifies the node term at packaging time and, when unstable entries exist, their last entry index and entry term. It is a descriptor of completion owed by the application, not an observation that IO has occurred.
facts.validity_context: Produced for asynchronous local append processing. The documented response contract covers this Ready and all prior Ready storage work. Step only uses its entry stabilization component when its nonzero message term survives term filtering.
representation: pb.Message Type MsgStorageAppendResp, From LocalAppendThread, To r.id, Term r.Term
Index and LogTerm populated whenever hasNextOrInProgressUnstableEnts is true
facts.durability: Message construction is volatile; the caller owes completion of durable storage before delivering the response. No executed storage observation is claimed.
facts.recovery: Descriptor is volatile local work; restart reconstructs log and hard state from Storage instead of replaying this message object. See B_recovery.

facts.meaning: For each peer, the current tracker Match is the largest index recorded by progress initialization or accepted append acknowledgments. Quorum calculation consumes it only for configured voters. It is volatile leader bookkeeping, not a direct disk observation.

identity.owner: local raft instance and current tracker

facts.validity_context: Interpreted under current term and active configuration. Incoming replies first pass Step term checks. Leader self Match is initialized to lastIndex on reset; new appends wait for self MsgAppResp before raising it.
facts.durability: Volatile; meaning as persisted support depends on protocol producers and compliant storage completion before response delivery.
facts.recovery: Restart/restore reconstruct progress; ordinary role reset clears remote Match and initializes self to local log lastIndex.

facts.meaning: raftLog.committed bounds the prefix declared committed locally. It advances from leader current-term quorum calculation, accepted leader append/heartbeat, snapshot, or stored HardState; it does not imply local persistence or completed application of that prefix.
facts.validity_context: Established decisions survive ordinary role/term reset; history conflict checks protect committed entries on append paths.
facts.durability: HardState and entries/snapshot must be persisted by the embedding storage path; committed may transiently exceed local stable extent.
facts.recovery: newLog seeds compacted prefix; loadState restores stored commit in range; snapshot restore can advance it.

surfaces.reason: Traced tracker voter support through joint/majority aggregation to the current-term log guard.
Traced application-time simple/joint membership activation and caller duties.
Traced acceptance, self completion steps and synchronous/asynchronous split.
Base read path mapped; the meaning of accumulated acknowledgments when voter configuration changes deserves a separate question.
The caller may bypass best-effort propose checks only with its own serialized validation; no such caller policy has been selected.

formation.explanation: A RawNode proposal synchronously enters Step; Node serializes the same proposal in node.run and returns the Step result. Followers forward or drop, candidates drop, and leaders reject removal/transfer/quota cases. Accepted entries acquire current term and next indexes, enter unstable log and are sent with predecessor identity. Follower maybeAppend matches that predecessor, refuses committed conflicts and bounds its new commit by the accepted extent; send defers its response until storage completion. The leader raises peer Match monotonically, computes majority support over active voters (both halves in joint state), and advances only at a matching current-term entry. Its own fresh support is likewise delayed by self MsgAppResp. Commitment propagates through appends and heartbeats capped at peer Match. Ready exposes committed entries; async mode waits for local stable extent, while synchronous mode relies on Ready handling order before Advance. Proposal return does not assert application or client completion.

context.explanation: Ticks or Campaign enter hup only when own progress is eligible, no snapshot is pending and no committed configuration change remains unapplied. Pre-vote leaves term/vote unchanged; real candidacy raises term and sends log-freshness-qualified votes to voter union, including storage-delayed self support. Matching response types and configured voter majorities decide election. Higher ordinary terms adopt follower state; same-term leader contact displaces candidates, stale replies are filtered, and CheckQuorum may relinquish leadership without a term change. Transfer suspends proposals until target catch-up/TimeoutNow or timeout. ApplyConfChange changes quorum and eligibility using simple/joint checks; outgoing voters remain until LeaveJoint. Restart reconstructs HardState and ConfState from Storage, and snapshots can replace suffix/configuration or fast-forward an already matching prefix.

connection.explanation: Authority transitions rebuild progress and vote tracking but preserve established committed log state. Delayed ordinary support from older terms is excluded; newly appended self support is not admitted until append completion. Stabilization requires both the response protocol term and matching unstable entry identity; snapshot completion survives stale protocol terms but clears only its matching pending snapshot. Application responses have zero term and continue advancing already committed work. Pending readOnly acknowledgments reset on role reset, while pre-current-term-commit read requests remain buffered and require a later current-term commit plus configured read protocol. Configuration application can reinterpret existing Match values and recompute commit. Unapplied committed configuration and pending snapshot barriers tie recovery/application to eligibility for the next authority context. These sourced mechanisms establish a usable investigation backbone, not proof that every history respects their intended meaning.

open_details: Exact divergent-log conflict-hint optimization across compacted terms and snapshot retry variants.
ReadOnlySafe pending requests across configuration changes and request-context reuse.
DisableConfChangeValidation with a caller-managed configuration queue; StepDownOnRemoval disabled behavior.
Crash atomicity of an embedding disk storage and client deduplication are outside the captured core implementation.
core_overview.rationale: Both core paths and their storage, membership, recovery, application and API boundaries are traced through concrete callers/callees. Remaining items are specific variants; usability permits scoped questions and does not establish correctness.
